Generate Python code based on the following instruction. Output ONLY code. DO NOT include explanations or other textual content.
Instruction: Generate code that creates an emulation using the seed-emulator library. The emulation should include base, routing, eBGP, iBGP, OSPF, and web service layers. It should define a function to create a stub autonomous system with a web server and a router that join a network and an internet exchange. The code should create three internet exchanges and multiple stub autonomous systems that join these exchanges. It should also create two autonomous systems with routers that join different networks and internet exchanges. The code should define private peerings between different autonomous systems. Finally, it should add a BGP attacker component that hijacks certain prefixes and joins an internet exchange. The code should merge the BGP attacker with the emulator and render the new emulator. The code should compile the new emulator using Docker and output the result to a specified directory.

```python
from seed_emulator import (
    Emulator,
    BaseLayer,
    RoutingLayer,
    EBGP,
    IBGP,
    OSPF,
    WebServiceLayer,
    InternetExchange,
    Network,
    AutonomousSystem,
    Router,
    Host,
    WebServer,
    BGPHijacker,
    PrivatePeering,
    merge_emulators,
)
import os

def create_stub_as(asn, ix, net, name_prefix):
    # Create stub AS with one router and one web server
    stub_as = AutonomousSystem(asn=asn, name=f"{name_prefix}-as{asn}")
    router = Router(name=f"{name_prefix}-r{asn}")
    host = Host(name=f"{name_prefix}-h{asn}")
    web = WebServer(name=f"{name_prefix}-web{asn}")
    stub_as.add(router)
    stub_as.add(host)
    stub_as.add(web)
    net.add(host)
    net.add(web)
    net.add(router)
    ix.add(router)
    stub_as.add_layer(IBGP())
    stub_as.add_layer(OSPF())
    stub_as.add_layer(WebServiceLayer())
    return stub_as

# Create base emulator and layers
emu = Emulator(name="multi-as-emulation")
emu.add_layer(BaseLayer())
emu.add_layer(RoutingLayer())
emu.add_layer(EBGP())
emu.add_layer(IBGP())
emu.add_layer(OSPF())
emu.add_layer(WebServiceLayer())

# Create Internet Exchanges
ix1 = InternetExchange(name="IX1")
ix2 = InternetExchange(name="IX2")
ix3 = InternetExchange(name="IX3")
emu.add(ix1)
emu.add(ix2)
emu.add(ix3)

# Create Networks
net1 = Network(name="NET1", prefix="10.1.0.0/24")
net2 = Network(name="NET2", prefix="10.2.0.0/24")
net3 = Network(name="NET3", prefix="10.3.0.0/24")
emu.add(net1)
emu.add(net2)
emu.add(net3)

# Create stub ASes and connect to IXes
stub_ases = []
stub_ases.append(create_stub_as(65001, ix1, net1, "stub1"))
stub_ases.append(create_stub_as(65002, ix2, net2, "stub2"))
stub_ases.append(create_stub_as(65003, ix3, net3, "stub3"))
stub_ases.append(create_stub_as(65004, ix1, net2, "stub4"))
stub_ases.append(create_stub_as(65005, ix2, net3, "stub5"))
stub_ases.append(create_stub_as(65006, ix3, net1, "stub6"))

for asys in stub_ases:
    emu.add(asys)

# Create two main ASes with routers joining different networks and IXes
as100 = AutonomousSystem(asn=65100, name="AS100")
r100a = Router(name="r100a")
r100b = Router(name="r100b")
as100.add(r100a)
as100.add(r100b)
net1.add(r100a)
ix1.add(r100a)
net2.add(r100b)
ix2.add(r100b)
as100.add_layer(IBGP())
as100.add_layer(OSPF())
emu.add(as100)

as200 = AutonomousSystem(asn=65200, name="AS200")
r200a = Router(name="r200a")
r200b = Router(name="r200b")
as200.add(r200a)
as200.add(r200b)
net2.add(r200a)
ix2.add(r200a)
net3.add(r200b)
ix3.add(r200b)
as200.add_layer(IBGP())
as200.add_layer(OSPF())
emu.add(as200)

# Define private peerings between different ASes
emu.add(PrivatePeering(as1=as100, as2=as200, routers=[(r100b, r200a)]))
emu.add(PrivatePeering(as1=stub_ases[0], as2=as100, routers=[(stub_ases[0].get("stub1-r65001"), r100a)]))
emu.add(PrivatePeering(as1=stub_ases[1], as2=as200, routers=[(stub_ases[1].get("stub2-r65002"), r200a)]))
emu.add(PrivatePeering(as1=stub_ases[2], as2=as100, routers=[(stub_ases[2].get("stub3-r65003"), r100b)]))

# Add BGP attacker component
bgp_attacker = Emulator(name="bgp-attacker")
attacker_as = AutonomousSystem(asn=66666, name="AttackerAS")
attacker_router = Router(name="attacker-router")
attacker_as.add(attacker_router)
ix1.add(attacker_router)
bgp_hijacker = BGPHijacker(router=attacker_router, hijack_prefixes=["10.1.0.0/24", "10.2.0.0/24"])
attacker_as.add(bgp_hijacker)
bgp_attacker.add(attacker_as)

# Merge BGP attacker with main emulator
emu_merged = merge_emulators(emu, bgp_attacker)

# Render and compile the emulator
emu_merged.render()
output_dir = "./emulator_output"
os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
emu_merged.compile(backend="docker", output_dir=output_dir)
```
